mov: Liberal and national revolutions across Europe: the 'Springtime of Nations', mostly crushed within two years.
Movement for Italian unity and independence: Mazzini, Garibaldi and Cavour; the Kingdom of Italy was proclaimed in 1861.
periods.glance: Italian Nationalists, 1848. About 1.62 million people in 1848 (model estimate). Movements: Revolutions of 1848, Risorgimento.
